Career Snapshot
Business intelligence developer who turns messy operational data into reports people actually open.
Eight years in insurance and finance reporting, now drawn to the engineering side of the data stack:
pipelines, orchestration and warehouse design. My next step is a Data Engineer position where I can
build the pipelines behind the dashboards I have been maintaining for years.

o Mentor two junior developers and run the fortnightly report review with the claims team
o Agreed a data dictionary with Finance, Claims and Underwriting after six workshops
Technologies: SQL Server, SSIS, Power BI, DAX, Azure Data Factory
